manual_preset.evaluation_anchor: run-0 6.44B checkpoint: 475/1024 single-level ROM clears in prior evaluation

limitations: Parity qualification is finite, not exhaustive. The original A/P register mismatches had identical RAM and do not establish the cause of poor learning.
New practice bank covers early 4-4 and 7-4, not complete maze routes; 8-4 coverage is confined to its first castle area.
Natural practice bands are ordered by achieved progress, not verified successful suffixes.
Maze loop counters are not explicit observation fields; whether recurrent state resolves the ambiguity has not been established.
No longer training run has established that the new reward, retention or practice choices improve ROM success.
